rv.q: BrightSide has created the perfect noir play.
For theatre-enthusiasts, or anyone looking for an entertaining night at the theatre, without the fuss and bother of going downtown Chicago, BrightSide’s Deathtrap production will more than satisfy.
BrightSide Theatre’s Season of Passion continues with this well-produced revival of one of theatre’s finest comic-mysteries.

cn.t: BrightSide Theatre delivers a solid revival of Ira Levin's Broadway record-holder, with critics praising this comedic thriller's enduring appeal and the production's faithful execution of the classic's twists and turns.
